profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at ManhattanLife
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in SQL, Requirements Analysis, Enterprise Software, Agile Methodologies, and Business Process Improvement. Strong engineering professional with a Master's degree focused in Computer Science from University of Houston.

positions.title: Integration Consultant
positions.description:
(Contract through CAPCO and subcontract through Ledgent Technology)
•	Worked with an Integration Team to implement the payment system for Engie Retail Subdivision.
•	Built the integration pieces from ground up to bridge the communication between two totally different systems, Forte (online payment system) and CES BLUE Billing Load Usage & EDI (online Billing system).  Utilize a lot of different API calls GET, POST, UPDATE, DELETE between systems.
•	Architected a way to convert from schedule payment to real transaction.
•	Being expert in Forte payment system.  Our teammates used me as consulting basis.  
•	Helped a junior integrator to come up with a design on his payment settlement process.  
•	Beside payment process, I also created Block Billing process from ground up. 
•	Analyzed CRM XML files from Siebel and came up solutions to update CES Billing system for Block (a block of price).  
•	Wrote more than 60+ Dell Boomi processes and called 30+ different API calls.  
•	Successful delivery a high performance payments and robust Block Billing Integration systems.
•	Utilized Forte Webhook return from Forte Transaction Processor to update CES payment.
•	Decided how the Billing Account link to payment system and set the payment to a specific status, such as Pending, Reject, Cancel in CES system.
•	Designed more than 16 different Payment Visio to describe the payment workflows and processes.
•	Certify in Dell Boomi Production Administration.
Tools: Dell Boomi Integration Platform, CES/Customized Energy Solutions BLUE. Groovy Script, Dell Boomi Atom Cloud, Forte Checkout, Forte.js, Forte APIs, Oracle Siebel CRM system, JSON, XML, CSV

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(acquired IHS's Syntex in Jun 2016), Houston TX
(IHS acquired Syntex in Sep 2010), Houston TX
•	Wore different hats on the team, Scrum master, VSTS administrator, SharePoint administrator, Build and Deployment specialist, Package specialist, web developer
•	Scrum master work involved in set up a goal for a Sprint, Planning Meeting, Scrum Meeting, creating Features and PBIs, conducting demo and holding Retrospective meeting
•	Experimented with Microsoft Bot Framework to create incident record in AI experience
•	Major architectural restructuring CSS to separate out customer CSS vs system CSS
•	Mentoring junior developers, up to 6, to get familiar with the IMPACT applications
•	With good communication skills, created a lot of technical documents to share with teammates
•	Utilized SonarQube result to address some vulnerability of the application, such as SQL Injection Attack.
•	Installed and maintained Azure VM
•	Involved with Incident Modernization project and utilized Aurelia UI Framework
•	Excel Proof of Concept on Configuration Utility using Excel JavaScript API
•	Worked with memory leak project to troubleshoot with teammates
•	While Architect and Director away, I had the honor being in charge of the whole development team
•	Modified MSBuild script to compile different CPU platforms (64bits vs. 32bits)
•	Moved TFS Build from TFS2008 to TFS2013 by installing and configuring Build Controller and Agents
•	Volunteering to lead ORM Colleague Engagement meeting to discuss and seek for further actions
•	Automate local IDE build process to ease the pain to manually build projects individually
•	Worked on PowerShell/ batch script to automate deployment msi and install it into QA servers
•	Designed and implemented a major component Option Menu utilizing JQuery and AJax in IMPACT 6.0
•	Took the new leadership role on 5.4.1 project and delivered the project on time and on budget
•	Assisted ArtinSoft successful to convert legacy VB6 application to .Net

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented three-tier architecture of Scion Web reporting project from ground up.
•	Created more than twenty presentation, business, and data layer COM objects and submitted them into COM+ service.  Utilized many different XSL style sheets to transform DB2 XML data into HTML pages.
Tools: VB/COM, ASP, DB2/stored procedures, XML, XSLT, HTML, JavaScript, VBScript, IIS, SourceSafe

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
•	Created COM objects for handling business logic as well as COM objects for generating presentation tier web pages.  Constructed over one hundred views and triggers for both SQL Server and Oracle. 
•	Designed and implemented framework changes to IMPACT Exec, a high-performance dynamic reporting product.  The framework changes improved upon user interfaces and enhanced functionality such as enabling drill-though reporting, saving custom user reports, and boosting report generation speed.
Tools: VB/COM, ASP, SQL Sever, Oracle, View, Trigger, XML, HTML, JavaScript, VBScript, IIS, SQL, SourceSafe, Perforce WinMerge

positions.title: Associate (Developer/Analyst)
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed and implemented an n-tier Portal utilizing Sequoia and ASP as a collaborative/development tool. Designed, developed and implemented more than thirty COM objects and submitted them into MTS.  Created many different XSL style sheets to transform XML data into HTML format; then displayed the pages on web browsers.  Constructed over one hundred T-SQL stored procedures for data consumer (COM) to access.  Created Use Cases to capture system requirements. 
•	Designed, developed and implemented workflow projects utilizing Jetform FormFlow 99 (Web Form) and InTempo (Workflow Routing Sever).  Completed Workflow web application from ground up.  Participated in client meeting to gather requirements. Planned and implemented Process Map, Roles Set and Routing Rule so that a web form would route correctly to a particular employee in the company. 
Tools: VB/COM, ASP, SQL Sever/ Stored procedure, Trigger, XML, XSL, Sequoia, HTML, JavaScript, VBScript, IIS, MTS, T-SQL, Jetform FormFlow 99, InTempo, Oracle, Crystal Report

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed Home Health database project built with user friendly tree view interfaces. 
•	Designed, developed and implemented MobilStar Billing System requiring extensive use of DAO, RDO, stored procedures, Win32 API.  Utilized three-tier architectural approach, VB front-end, COM mid-tier, and SQL server back-end. 
•	Contributed to the development of Compaq Global Image Library Maintenance System, which involved managing thousands of images from the web site.  
Tools: VB/COM, SQL Sever/stored procedure, Trigger, T-SQL, ASP, VBScript, Crystal Report.
